description: Use after the buyer completes the payment action for a checkout created by prepare_repair. APPLE_PAY verifies the existing Tap charge by checkoutId; BASE_USDC and TRON_USDT require the payer-provided txHash. A confirmed payment returns verified=true, while an already-confirmed Apple Pay checkout may return alreadyVerified=true; an unconfirmed or rejected payment returns error and/or reason without fabricating success. Verification may also return the job attached by the existing payment-completion workflow. This tool never creates or sends a transaction and never charges the buyer.

checkoutId.description: Exact checkout ID returned by prepare_repair.

rail.description: Use the same payment rail selected in prepare_repair.

txHash.description: Payer-provided transaction hash. Required for BASE_USDC and TRON_USDT after transfer submission; omit for APPLE_PAY.

name: verify_repair

outputSchema.description: Verification status for an existing checkout payment. Treat verified=true or alreadyVerified=true as confirmed; otherwise inspect error/reason/state and do not assume payment success.

alreadyVerified.description: True when an APPLE_PAY checkout had already been verified previously.

error.description: Present when payment is missing, unavailable, invalid or could not be verified.

job.description: Existing repair job attached by the payment-completion workflow when available; may be null.

paymentId.description: Recorded verified payment identifier when available.

phase.description: VERIFY when the verification route returned a structured result.

reason.description: Verification evidence or rejection reason when returned by a wallet rail.

state.description: Payment/checkout state when returned; PAYMENT_VERIFIED denotes a confirmed payment.

verified.description: True only when the provider/chain evidence confirms the expected payment for this checkout.

title: Verify Repair Payment
